entities.summary: Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum is a Ghanaian politician and a member of parliament for the Nkoranza South Constituency in the Bono East Region of Ghana. In May 2022, he alleged that the Ghana Police fired live bullets during the Nkoranza shooting and called on Ghanaians to stand against police brutality. He is currently the member of the 9th parliament.
